WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as baseline_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
combinations AS (
  SELECT 
    s.transref,
    tr.tradekind,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
),
with_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    c.transref,
    c.tradekind,
    c.avg_optvolrt,
    c.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_optvolrt as deviation
  FROM combinations c
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviations
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    w.transref,
    w.tradekind,
    w.avg_optvolrt,
    w.deviation,
    t.type_avg_deviation,
    w.deviation - t.type_avg_deviation as excess
  FROM with_deviations w
  JOIN type_stats t ON w.tradekind = t.tradekind
  WHERE w.deviation > t.type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt_of_kept,
  AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation_of_kept,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess_of_kept
FROM filtered
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind
